# Agents

- Defaults live in `src/settings/defaults.ts`; retries are set at `src/settings/defaults.ts:40`.
- Check the docs with `npm run lint:docs` and `make check-docs`.
- Build with `npm run buld`, test with `npm run tset`, and start the dev server with `npm run dov`.
- Run the CLI as `mytool --colour auto --quiet`.
